description: Floors for the deterministic retrieval-health evaluator (bench/eval_retrieval.py). ADDITIVE ONLY: these are new metrics introduced alongside the retrieval-access hardening and do not replace or weaken any threshold in thresholds_v1.json. Every floor is calibrated BELOW the observed offline value (headroom) so the evaluator passes while a real regression — cooldowns not applied, failed URLs re-fetched, fallback not substituting — trips it. Scenario pass/fail is asserted per-case in code; these floors guard the aggregates.
